CustomField.description: Denormalized Main Holder display name for the Opportunity (Grupo y Main Holder en Opportunity tras migración Multiholder). For Multiholder Opportunities this is the client flagged via Custom_Association_Opportunity__c.g_customer_id__c; for non-Multiholder Opportunities it is the Opportunity's own Account name. Populated automatically (DMT_OpportunityGroupHolderService) so Reports and other processes can read it directly without needing the full Multiholder structure.
CustomField.label: Main Holder Name
